title: Survey closed
description: A Tenant closed a survey, so its links answer 404 from that moment and every visit that was still in progress is marked abandoned. Reopening a survey publishes a new version, which is a separate `survey-version.published` event; this one reports only the close. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

current_version_id.description: The version that was current at the close, so a receiver knows which document the last responses belong to. Null only for a survey closed before it was ever published.

closed_at.description: When the survey closed, in UTC.
